intro.title: An Angolan services company for Oil & Gas and Mining.
intro.body: Fully Angolan-owned, we were founded by professionals with over 15 years of experience in Project Management in the Oil & Gas industry. We work with an ESG focus and the energy transition in mind, creating value for investors, employees and local communities.
points: Deep knowledge of the Angolan oil market

about.title: The Angolan partner for strategic sourcing and local content.
about.lead: ENERYETU – COMÉRCIO & SERVIÇOS LDA is a services company operating in the Oil & Gas and Mining industries.
about.body1: Fully Angolan-owned, it was founded by Angolan professionals with over 15 years of experience in Project Management in the Oil & Gas industry — with deep knowledge of the national oil market.
about.body2: Committed to ESG principles, it promotes sustainable practices and the energy transition, pursuing strategic partnerships that generate value for investors, employees and local communities.
about.vision: To be Africa's leading platform for Strategic Sourcing and Local Content, positioning Angola as a competitive hub for global industrial supply chains.
about.mission: To create and facilitate business opportunities for national and international companies through integrated market-access and business-development solutions.
